Markets.title: US stocks today: Dow Jones crashes 500 pts, Nasdaq over 2.5% as AI cash burn fears spark tech selloff
Markets.summary: US stocks tumbled on Friday, led by a steep tech sell-off driven by disappointing earnings from Intel and Amazon. The downturn was fueled by investor concerns over escalating artificial intelligence spending and uncertain financial returns.

Markets.title: Nasdaq 100 cracks 5%, wipes out $2 trillion in October as AI spending fears deepen
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq 100 dropped over 5% and lost $2 trillion in October due to growing investor anxiety over high artificial intelligence spending. Major tech companies like Meta, Alphabet, and Microsoft are increasing their capital outlays for AI infrastructure amid rising borrowing costs.

Markets.title: Reddit stock plunges 30% as Google's AI search threatens traffic and user growth
Markets.summary: Reddit shares dropped after the company warned that Google's AI-powered search features are reducing referral traffic and threatening user growth. Pinterest shares also fell following a weaker revenue outlook caused by pressure on European cross-border sellers.

Markets.title: Intel stock plunges 30% as weak PC demand and AI costs trigger global chip selloff
Markets.summary: Intel shares plunged 30% after the company issued a weak revenue forecast and warned of negative cash flow for the year. This warning triggered a global semiconductor selloff, with Nvidia, AMD, and other chip stocks declining due to weak PC demand and rising AI costs.

Markets.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings
Markets.summary: Sun Pharma reported a 36% decline in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 1,989 crore due to exceptional litigation and acquisition costs. Despite this profit drop, revenue grew by 11.8% driven by strong domestic and emerging market sales.

Markets.title: Syrma SGS reports best-ever quarter; Q2 revenue up 73% to Rs 1,999.5 crore
Markets.summary: Syrma SGS Technology reported a record-high quarterly revenue of Rs 1,999.5 crore, marking a 73.2% increase year-on-year for the quarter ending September 2026. Consolidated net profit grew by 87.2%, driven by a 91% surge in exports and strong international demand.

Geo-Political.title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
Geo-Political.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance is trying to recover $6.3 billion stolen in what is believed to be the largest cyber-attack of its kind. Investigators have linked the complex hack to North Korea.

Geo-Political.title: US inmate Christa Pike says she woke up 'confused and in pain' after failed execution
Geo-Political.summary: US inmate Christa Pike released her first public statement since surviving a botched lethal injection execution attempt in September. She stated that she woke up confused and in pain following the failed procedure.

Geo-Political.title: Hundreds evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during rare Ukraine ceasefire
Geo-Political.summary: Hundreds of people were evacuated from the Russian-occupied front-line town of Oleshky during a rare ceasefire agreed upon by Ukraine. Despite the ongoing dangers, hundreds of other residents chose to remain in the town.

Geo-Political.title: They strangled us, says founder of Russian newspaper shut under pressure from authorities
Geo-Political.summary: The founder of Novaya Gazeta stated that authorities pressured and ultimately strangled the prominent independent Russian newspaper until it was forced to shut down. The outlet had operated as one of Russia's most high-profile independent news sources for the past thirty years.

Geo-Political.title: Spain transport minister says he won't resign over high-speed rail disaster
Geo-Political.summary: Spanish Transport Minister Óscar Puente has refused to resign following a high-speed train collision earlier in the week that killed at least 69 people. He faces intense pressure to step down in the wake of the fatal disaster.

Geo-Political.title: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pontiff to vote in a US election
Geo-Political.summary: Pope Leo XIV became the first pontiff to vote in a US election by mailing in a ballot for the midterm elections. The Chicago-born pope has a tense relationship with Donald Trump.

Data & Insights.title: Govt sets up high-level banking panel under Suresh N. Patel
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has established a high-level banking panel led by Suresh N. Patel to review the nation's banking sector. The committee will recommend reforms to make the sector globally competitive, financially inclusive, and resilient by 2047.

Data & Insights.title: Extreme poverty in India falls to 2.6% from 27.1%: World Bank
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2011 and 2023, 496 million people in India rose above the lower-middle-income poverty line. Consequently, the World Bank reported that extreme poverty in the country dropped from 27.1% to 2.6%.

Data & Insights.title: ‘2026 resembles 1991’: Why CEA V Anantha Nageswaran wants India to rethink its growth strategy — what he said
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran warned that global tensions and supply-chain shocks threaten India's access to critical resources. He urged the country to rethink its growth strategy by strengthening domestic capabilities, diversifying imports, and building strategic buffers.

Data & Insights.title: West Asia conflict drives 15-20% surge in working capital demand at Indian banks, lifts corporate credit growth: Report
Data & Insights.summary: The conflict in West Asia increased working-capital demand at Indian banks by 15 to 20 percent due to higher raw-material costs and shipping delays. This surge, along with refinancing and acquisition borrowing, helped boost corporate credit growth in the September quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What does the proposed India-Mexico preferential trade agreement mean for Indian exporters?
Data & Insights.summary: A proposed preferential trade agreement could help Indian exporters improve price competitiveness in Mexico. This improvement would come through negotiated tariff concessions on Indian goods.

Data & Insights.title: Economy can sustain high-growth trajectory in FY27, recent GST reforms to help: Finmin review
Data & Insights.summary: The Finance Ministry reports that the Indian economy can maintain a high-growth trajectory in FY27, supported by recent GST reforms. However, the Department of Economic Affairs noted in its October review that persistent global uncertainties like high oil prices and inflation require ongoing vigilance.

India.title: ISRO Launches Next-Gen Satellite To Strengthen Indigenous GPS System
India.summary: ISRO launched the NVS-03 satellite, which is the third spacecraft in the second-generation NVS series. This mission is designed to strengthen India's indigenous NavIC satellite navigation system.

India.title: Amit Shah's 'Special' Offer To INDIA Bloc Before Gyanesh Kumar's 'Public Impeachment'
India.summary: At a party event in Lucknow, Amit Shah challenged Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav to a special parliamentary session to discuss the BJP's stance. He stated that the party is fully prepared and has nothing to hide regarding the matter.

India.title: Delhi Records Coldest October Day In 75 Years After Heavy Rain, Clean Air
India.summary: Delhi experienced its coldest October day in 75 years following heavy rain and clean air. The sudden drop in temperature brought shallow fog and caused residents to wear warm clothes as the mercury fell well below normal.

India.title: BJP Leader's Singer Wife, A Kabir Bhajan Gone Viral, And The 'Jantar Mantar' That Wasn't
India.summary: A viral video of singer Sivasri Skandaprasad performing a Kabir bhajan was misinterpreted as a political jab at protests in Delhi's Jantar Mantar. The song's actual lyrics reference a spiritual concept by the poet Kabir rather than the physical protest site.

India.title: AAP Claims Government Jobs Halting Punjab Migration, BJP Blames Visa Rules
India.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann claimed that government jobs are stopping young people from migrating abroad. In response, the BJP argued that international visa regulations are actually responsible for the change in migration patterns.

India.title: 'Does A Man Not Have Right To End Relationship?' Supreme Court On False Rape Cases
India.summary: The Supreme Court questioned whether a man has the right to end a relationship. The bench clarified that ending a relationship does not make earlier consensual sex a crime.
